answer: A random spot-check of walnut capsules makes each clone stake a $120 copper bond it cannot share. Each agent seals one capsule holding a unique shard of the shared ledger, plus a $45 storage receipt. Every epoch, three rotating auditors demand three random shards within 90 seconds; a missed reply burns the bond and voids the capsule. Clones copying one capsule trip the same-shard detector, so all 100 forfeit together: $12,000 in bonds gone chasing $900 of nectar rewards, while one honest agent risks $165 for a $9 share. A hive lets one bee sip nectar; it stings a hundred thieves at once.
